name: Capsule
description_en:
Capsule is a CRM that connects people and organization records with sales opportunities, tasks and delivery projects. The sales pipeline tracks work toward a won or lost decision; Projects carries client work beyond the sale. Custom fields, tags and interaction history supply context around these records.

A useful reason to evaluate Capsule is keeping the commercial handoff and the subsequent work together. That does not make every project or marketing requirement part of the base CRM: automated workflows depend on the plan, and Transpond is a marketing add-on. This profile follows a representative contact-to-opportunity-to-project path and explains documentation-specific setup and failure conditions. It contains no account trial, independent review or verified revenue outcome.
description_zh:
Capsule 将个人和组织记录与销售机会、任务及交付项目连接起来。销售管线跟踪业务走向成交或流失的过程，Projects 则承接成交后的客户工作。自定义字段、标签和互动历史为这些记录提供背景。

若希望把商业交接和后续工作放在一起，Capsule 值得评估。但这不表示基础 CRM 覆盖所有项目或营销需求：自动化工作流受套餐限制，Transpond 属于营销附加项。本文沿着联系人、机会到项目的代表性路径，说明文档中的配置及失败条件；未实际试用、独立审稿或验证收入成果。

core_features.explanation_en: Use contact history, tags and custom fields to keep the relevant customer information together.
core_features.explanation_zh: 用联系人历史、标签和自定义字段汇集相关客户信息。

core_features.explanation_en: Track opportunities through custom stages and a Won/Lost outcome.
core_features.explanation_zh: 让机会按自定义阶段推进至成交或流失。

core_features.explanation_en: Associate project tasks with customer contacts and reuse Tracks for repeatable work.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把项目任务关联到客户联系人，并用 Tracks 复用重复工作步骤。

core_features.explanation_en: Use opportunity or project transitions to start configured actions; plan and setup conditions apply.
core_features.explanation_zh: 用机会或项目阶段变化启动已配置动作，需满足套餐和配置条件。

en: Track a service quotation and retain its customer context.
Start a delivery project and repeatable checklist after a sale.
zh: 跟踪服务报价并保留客户背景。
成交后启动交付项目和可复用任务清单。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative tasks based on documentation, not observed deployments.

Service model.en: Browser-accessed hosted service under customer terms; client apps and API are described by the support site.
Service model.zh: 根据客户条款通过浏览器访问托管服务；支持站点另说明客户端及 API。

steps.en: Prepare separate person and organization rows and review the import field preview.
steps.zh: 分别准备个人和组织行，核对导入字段预览。

steps.en: Define a sales milestone and the project checklist needed after winning.
steps.zh: 定义销售里程碑及成交后所需项目清单。

steps.en: An administrator should test a workflow, inspect the result and then activate it; remove test records from reporting when finished.
steps.zh: 管理员应测试工作流、核对结果后再启用，并在完成后清理影响报表的测试记录。

items.name: Transpond marketing add-on
items.scope: Activated from Capsule; confirm marketing entitlement and sending capacity separately.

items.en: Workflow Automation is available on Growth, Advanced and Ultimate; administrators create or update configurations.
items.zh: Workflow Automation 在 Growth、Advanced 和 Ultimate 提供；配置创建及修改由管理员完成。

items.en: A Track-completion follow-up can be skipped if the record leaves the configured milestone before the Track completes.
items.zh: 如果 Track 完成前记录离开配置的里程碑，完成后的后续动作可能不执行。

pricing.billing_basis: Paid plans advertised per user/month with annual or monthly payment; marketing add-on separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free: up to two users and 250 contacts. Paid plans Starter, Growth, Advanced and Ultimate offer 14-day trials. Retrieved paid seat amounts were not rendered.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Free：最多2用户、250联系人。付费套餐 Starter、Growth、Advanced、Ultimate 提供14天试用；读取文本未渲染付费席位金额。

faq.question_en: Does a paid trial establish ongoing free access to automations?
faq.question_zh: 付费套餐试用是否代表自动化可持续免费使用？
faq.answer_en: No. Compare the retained plan with the workflow entitlement. The ongoing Free plan is distinct from the 14-day paid-plan trial.
faq.answer_zh: 不能。应按长期保留的套餐核对工作流权益；持续 Free 套餐与14天付费套餐试用不同。

faq.question_en: Is a test workflow completely separate from reports?
faq.question_zh: 测试工作流是否完全独立于报表？
faq.answer_en: No. The guide says test Opportunities count in sales or activity reports; remove them when evaluation ends.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。指南说明测试机会会计入销售或活动报表，评估完成后应清理。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Keep the customer separate from the deal
sections.en:
Capsule describes storing interactions on contact records and tailoring them with tags and custom fields. A customer relationship may therefore outlive any one sales opportunity. For a hypothetical consulting firm, keep the buying organization and its people as customer records, then associate a particular piece of work with an opportunity.

Choose a small set of fields that explain the next action: source, service interest and accountable owner, for example. Decide which information belongs to the organization and which belongs to a person. The contact feature page does not prove that messages outside connected channels will appear automatically; check capture behavior for the actual mailbox or integration.
sections.zh:
Capsule 描述在联系人记录上保存互动，并用标签和自定义字段调整信息。客户关系可以跨越多次销售机会。以假设的咨询公司为例，可把采购组织及其成员保留为客户记录，再为某项具体工作建立关联机会。

建议先选能解释下一动作的少量字段，例如来源、服务意向和负责人，并区分哪些信息属于组织、哪些属于个人。联系人功能页不能证明连接渠道之外的消息会自动出现，应验证实际邮箱或集成的采集方式。

sections.title_en: An opportunity is a decision process
sections.en:
The sales feature describes customizable milestones, Kanban movement, list views and Won/Lost outcomes. An illustrative sequence for a consulting quotation might be qualification, discovery and proposal, followed by the outcome. These names are an editorial example, not required Capsule defaults.

A milestone should mean a decision or completed condition, not merely that someone dragged a card. Before relying on forecasts, define what values and expected dates mean and inspect a deliberately stalled opportunity. A forecast is an interpretation of the data entered, not evidence that future revenue is guaranteed.
sections.zh:
销售功能页说明可自定义里程碑、拖动看板、使用列表视图以及标记成交／流失。咨询报价可假设按资格判断、需求了解、提案及最终结果推进。这些名称是编辑示例，不是 Capsule 必须采用的默认阶段。

里程碑应表示决策或完成条件，而不只是有人拖动卡片。依赖预测前，应定义金额和预计日期的含义，并检查刻意停滞的机会。预测是对录入数据的解释，不能保证未来收入。

sections.title_en: Carry the sale into a delivery project
sections.en:
Projects links work to customer contacts and provides task assignment and list or Kanban views. Reusable Tracks describe repeatable steps; the product pages describe starting delivery from a won opportunity. For an example onboarding process, define an introduction task, requirements review and a delivery sign-off, then give each an owner.

Separate project creation from project completion. Having the next record and checklist ready does not establish that the client received the service. If your delivery requires resource scheduling, time billing or complex dependencies, treat those as requirements to verify rather than importing every capability associated with the phrase project management.
sections.zh:
Projects 把工作关联到客户联系人，提供任务分配以及列表或看板视图。可复用的 Tracks 表达重复步骤，产品页说明能从成交机会启动交付。以客户入门为例，可定义介绍沟通、需求复核和交付签收，并分别指定负责人。

应区分创建项目和完成项目。下条记录及清单已就绪，不代表客户已经收到服务。如果交付还需资源排期、工时计费或复杂依赖，应把它们列作待核需求，不能由“项目管理”一词推断全部具备。

sections.title_zh: 阶段变化与 Track 完成
sections.en:
The workflow overview describes opportunity and project transitions triggering tasks, email and updates. Use those defined transitions rather than treating an arbitrary field edit as a universal trigger. A useful example is assigning a contract milestone to its responsible colleague and applying the relevant task Track.

The detailed guide adds an important condition: a completion action attached to a Track only runs while the record remains in the milestone where that action was set up. If a user advances the record early, completing the old checklist need not close or move it. Test that exception as well as the straight-through path before relying on the handoff.
sections.zh:
工作流总览描述由机会和项目阶段变化触发任务、邮件及更新。应基于已定义转换来设计，而不能把任意字段编辑都视为通用触发器。例如，可把合同阶段分配给负责同事，并应用相应任务 Track。

详细指南补充了重要条件：Track 的完成动作，只会在记录仍处于设置该动作的里程碑时执行。如果用户提前推进记录，完成旧清单不一定再触发关闭或移动。依赖交接前，除了顺利路径，也应测试这个异常。

sections.title_en: Understand test records and failed actions
sections.title_zh: 理解测试记录与失败动作
sections.en:
The guide requires a mailbox connection for user-sent automated email. It records action failures on the record's Automations tab and emails the Super Administrator. After fixing the record, its documented retrigger path is moving it out of and back into the relevant milestone. Inspect prior effects before doing that.

Testing creates Opportunities or Projects inside the pipeline or board; test Opportunities contribute to reports. Remove test data after evaluation. These details make a disposable-data pilot important. No retry timing, external transactional guarantee or live recovery was measured in this research.
sections.zh:
指南说明，以用户身份自动发送邮件时需要该用户已连接邮箱。动作失败会记录在记录的 Automations 页签，并通过邮件通知超级管理员。修正记录后，文档列出的再次触发方式是先移出、再移回相关里程碑；这样做之前应检查此前已产生的效果。

测试会在管线或看板内创建机会或项目，测试机会会进入报表，评估后应清理测试数据。因此建议使用可丢弃数据试点。本文未测量重试时机、外部事务保证或实际恢复。

sections.title_en: Import mapping can change existing values
sections.title_zh: 导入映射可能改变现有值
sections.en:
The import guide distinguishes person and organization rows. A named person row creates a person; an organization column links that person to the organization. If the organization needs its own address or other details, prepare an organization row with the person-name fields blank. Review the mapped sample before importing.

Duplicate handling offers creating new contacts, ignoring duplicates or updating them. An especially important distinction is that overwriting a multi-select custom field replaces current values, whereas imported tags append. Test a contact that already has data before bulk updates. A correct row count does not establish correct relationships or preserved fields.
sections.zh:
导入指南区分个人行和组织行。带个人姓名的行创建个人，组织列用于把该人关联到组织。如果组织需要独立地址等信息，应另准备组织行，并让个人姓名字段留空。导入前核对映射样例。

重复处理可选择新建、忽略或更新。一个重要区别是：覆盖多选自定义字段会替换当前值，而导入标签会追加。批量更新前应测试已有数据的联系人。行数正确不能证明关联正确或原字段得到保留。

sections.title_en: Free capacity, paid plans and marketing costs
sections.title_zh: 免费容量、付费套餐与营销费用
sections.en:
The current signup page lists Free for at most two users and 250 contacts, distinct from a 14-day trial of Starter, Growth, Advanced or Ultimate. Workflow Automations and access controls are listed with Growth. A downgrade must fit the destination plan's limits; a trial configuration is not evidence that those features persist on Free.

Paid CRM plans are presented per user/month with monthly or annual payment options, but the retrieved text did not contain their numeric seat amounts. The Marketing add-on is separately offered. Budget seat count, the intended plan and marketing capacity together, and obtain the selected currency/cadence at checkout. No stale comparison-page price is substituted for a missing current amount.
sections.zh:
当前注册页列出 Free 最多2用户和250联系人，与 Starter、Growth、Advanced、Ultimate 的14天试用不同。Workflow Automations 和访问控制列在 Growth 中；降级必须满足目标套餐限制，试用时可用不代表免费版能继续保留。

付费 CRM 套餐以每用户每月展示，并提供按月或按年付款，但读取文本未包含具体席位金额。Marketing 附加项另外提供。应把席位数、目标套餐和营销容量一起预算，再在结账时确认币种及周期；本文不使用过时对比页价格填补当前金额缺失。

sections.title_en: Hosted service terms and practical fit
sections.en:
The customer terms describe browser access to a hosted service, retain supplier intellectual property and do not grant source-code access. Paid subscriptions renew until cancelled; the terms distinguish immediate billing when upgrading an existing Free account from a fresh paid-plan trial. Keep those routes separate when budgeting an evaluation.

Capsule merits a closer look when the same team needs customer context, a sales process and a relatively direct delivery handoff. It needs more investigation for demanding external orchestration or procurement requirements. This research did not establish exact API quotas, data-location choices, regional signup/payment availability or an account-specific AI entitlement. No availability benchmark or independent quality rating is claimed.
sections.zh:
客户条款描述通过浏览器访问托管服务，软件知识产权由供应商保留，也不授予源代码访问权。付费订阅持续续订至取消；条款将已有 Free 账户升级时立即计费，与新开付费套餐试用区分开。预算评估成本时应分清入口。

当同一团队需要客户背景、销售流程及较直接的交付交接时，Capsule 值得进一步考察。复杂外部编排或采购要求则需更具体核查。本文未确认准确 API 额度、数据位置选择、地区注册／付款或具体账户的 AI 权益，也不提供可用性基准或独立质量评分。

secondary_questions: What happens when a Track finishes in another milestone?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent hypotheses, no demand or ranking measurement.
